gold_liquidity_analysis: XAUUSD swept the intraday liquidity low down to 3511.8 before aggressive institutional absorption and volume expansion (5372 and 3395 contracts) drove a strong recovery back to 3547.6. DXY is showing intraday weakness pushing down towards 103.94, supporting further precious metals upside.
trade_thesis: Following a classic liquidity sweep of the session lows and subsequent impulsive reclamation of the 3540 level, order flow has shifted heavily bullish. The market is positioned to retest the upper session highs around 3565 as trapped shorts provide fuel for a continuation rally.
